set.body: Implement the settled relational-analysis design for matched similarity, repeated-view similarity, deterministic baselines, temporal evaluation, and surface decomposition. Relation is a sealed inspectable ADT; PairDesign encodes only legal directed/undirected spaces; PairwiseAnalysis retains both keys; reductions and contrasts are explicit; bottom-k sampling is keyed, monotone in cap, and cross-platform; task-named conveniences are façades over shared primitives. PRD is normative.
set.title: Relational analysis: pair designs, edge results, and typed reductions
